Our Story

A Gulberg fixture on the city's most famous food road

MM Alam Road is where Lahore comes to eat — and Jade Café and Chinatown has held its corner of it by doing two things well at once. The café side keeps things relaxed: coffee, continental plates and long conversations. The Chinatown side brings the fire: Szechuan woks, family-style platters and a hi-tea spread that fills the room every afternoon.

Two kitchens, one table — and thousands of Lahoris who have made it their regular spot.
